sourceGaps: All 19 available keys are complete and present. Native source has no printed point values or marking rubric; none inferred.

Key booklet bears the competition and institutional names and individual author signatures, but separate external verification of official key provenance was not performed. All solutions use archive attribution and retain the printed names.

sourceContradictions.description: Question says lunar light is reflected equally in all directions; key adopts J=AP/(2πR²), with the beam perpendicular to the surface. Native wording, geometric-albedo assumption, denominator and +21.4 magnitude result retained.

Key first uses R for the 92 kpc galactocentric distance, then divides the transverse speed by R after stating the 84.7 kpc distance from the Sun. Both original distances and the reused symbol remain; no silent notation correction.

questionKeyEditionDifferences.description: Question sheet says рисунке справа; key removes справа. Original question wording retained, both native diagram occurrences preserved.
Question sheets say (на отдельной странице); key omits this parenthetical. Original wording and the actual full companion page are retained.
